frames.s: THINK YOU'RE TOO SLOW FOR A RUN CLUB?
frames.u: Read this before you make another excuse.
Someone is always slower. Someone always waits.
Old trainers have done plenty of club runs.
Nobody is checking your splits. Promise.
Half the club walks it. The other half lies.
And whether you're staying for coffee.

reel1.caption:
Too slow for a run club? Nobody there is checking.
Not your pace, not your shoes, not your watch, and definitely not who walked the hill.
Send this to your club's WhatsApp group.

#runclub #beginnerrunner #slowrunner #runningclub #PaceShark

frames.u: 4 tricks for when a run feels hard.
Most runs feel better once you're warm.
Then the next one. Then the next one.
Your brain can't moan and count at once.
Easier pace, same run. Still counts.

reel2.caption:
The first 2 km of almost every run lie to you.
Give it 10 minutes, run lamppost to lamppost, count your steps, and slow down before you stop.
Save this for your next long run.

#runningmindset #runningmotivation #mentaltoughness #longrun #PaceShark

slides.sub: Number 1 keeps a lot of runners at home. Swipe.

slides.title: WALKING IS CHEATING
slides.head: Walk breaks are a tool, not a failure.
slides.body: Plenty of runners finish marathons and ultras with planned walk breaks. Walking the hills is a strategy.

slides.title: REST DAYS ARE LAZY
slides.head: You get fitter while you rest.
slides.body: Training is the work. The rest day is when your body catches up and gets stronger.

slides.title: RUN EVERY DAY
slides.head: More days is not always better.
slides.body: Three or four good runs a week beat seven tired ones. Consistency over months is what counts.

slides.title: YOU MUST BE FAST
slides.head: Races are full of runners like you.
slides.body: Every start line has walkers, joggers and first-timers. Check the cut-off and go.

slides.title: ONE BAD RUN = UNFIT
slides.head: A bad day is just a bad day.
slides.body: Sleep, heat, work and stress all show up on your watch. Look at the month, not the morning.
